result_text:
The region ticket list now sorts high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority, the same as the sales-rep list.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I replaced the `ORDER BY t.opened_date, t.id` clause with the same `CASE` ordering that `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep` uses, and updated the Javadoc to match. The filters are unchanged, so closed tickets and other regions are still excluded.

I ran `SalesRepTest`, `RegionInvoicesTest` and `RegionShipmentsTest` offline, and all pass. No existing test calls `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` directly, so the new order isn't covered by a test. I didn't add one. Nothing is committed.
